meta.name: blue-ocean-strategy
meta.description: Create uncontested market space using value innovation instead of competing head-to-head. Use when the user mentions "blue ocean", "red ocean", "strategy canvas", "ERRC framework", "value innovation", "non-customers", "buyer utility map", "the market is too crowded", "how do we stand out", or "escape the price war". Also trigger when exploring a new market category, or finding underserved or non-customers. Covers the Four Actions Framework, Six Paths, buyer utility map, and value-cost trade-offs. For real strategy formulation and bad-strategy detection, see good-strategy-bad-strategy. For tech adoption strategy, see crossing-the-chasm. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用价值创新开辟无人竞争的新市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在红海中苦战，想找到没有竞争的新市场空间。
copy.tagline_en: Create uncontested market space through value innovation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're struggling in a red ocean and want to find uncontested market space.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用蓝海战略框架帮你分析市场，通过价值创新创造无竞争的新市场空间，而不是在红海中竞争。它会绘制战略画布、应用四步动作框架（ERRC）、探索六条路径，并评估你的战略得分。
howto.when: 当你提到“蓝海”、“红海”、“战略画布”、“ERRC框架”、“价值创新”、“非顾客”、“买方效用图”、“市场太拥挤”、“如何脱颖而出”或“逃离价格战”等关键词时触发。也适用于探索新市场类别或寻找未被充分服务的顾客时。

say.text: 帮我用蓝海战略分析一下我们公司的市场定位。
say.note: Claude 会绘制战略画布并给出ERRC建议。

say.text: 我们的产品在红海中，如何创造蓝海？
say.note: Claude 会引导你通过六条路径寻找新机会。

say.text: 用四步动作框架评估这个新想法。
say.note: Claude 会列出消除、减少、提升、创造的具体因素。
